description: This file defines the interface for the MSH3 QUIC implementation in curl, including function declarations for version reporting, creation, and connection checking related to MSH3 support.

methods.name: Curl_msh3_ver
methods.description: Reports the version of MSH3 being used.

methods.name: Curl_cf_msh3_create
methods.description: Creates and initializes an MSH3 filter context.

methods.name: Curl_conn_is_msh3
methods.description: Checks if the current connection is using MSH3.
